meta.objective: Get visitors to start a free trial
meta.verdict: One sentence: what is solid, and the single problem that costs the most.
meta.agent_access: Tag manager container (edit rights through its API, token in the agent environment)

strengths.text: HTTPS everywhere, www and http redirect to one canonical URL in a single hop.
Title (52 characters), meta description (148) and self-referencing canonical are all present.
Largest Contentful Paint is good and stable across 3 runs.
The page makes one clear promise and one primary call to action above the fold.
strengths.evidence: shots/mobile-01.png: headline + button 'Start free trial' visible without scrolling

findings.title: Third-party scripts block the main thread
findings.observation: Total Blocking Time is far above the 200 ms target, mostly caused by analytics and tag scripts.
findings.evidence: lh/summary.json: metrics.tbt_ms median 850; digest.bootup_top[1]: analytics.js scripting 678 ms
findings.action: Load analytics after first interaction, drop duplicate tags, remove unused modules.
fix_steps: Open the tag manager and list every tag that fires on page load (analytics, ads, chat).
Move analytics and chat to fire after the first user interaction or after consent.
Delete duplicate tags and any tag nobody uses.
Remove unused JavaScript modules from the theme or build.
findings.verify: Rerun lh_median.py on the page: median TBT at or under 200 ms and spread under 10 points.

execution.rollback: Save the current tag manager container version first; to undo, publish that previous version.

needs.what: Edit rights on the tag manager container (Google Tag Manager or equivalent)
Which tags may fire before consent, and which only after

findings.title: No proof near the main button
findings.observation: No testimonial, number of customers or logo appears within the first two screens.
findings.evidence: facts.json: no testimonial markup, 0 matches for review/rating terms; shots/mobile-02.png: second screen read
findings.action: Add one line of concrete proof (a number, a named result) under the headline.
fix_steps: Pick one real proof: a number of customers, a named result, or a short quote with a name.
Write one line under the headline, for example '1,200 teams started this month' with the real figure.
Check it fits on the first mobile screen without pushing the button down.
findings.verify: Open the page on a phone: the proof line is visible next to the main button without scrolling.

needs.what: One real customer number, or a quote with permission to publish it

not_measured: Real-user data (Search Console, CrUX) and INP: not available.
Only the home page was audited, not the checkout or sign-up flow.
